name: limit-resume
description: Resume an interrupted session after its usage limit resets

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages and of its notes to Claude

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for clock times, for example Europe/Berlin; empty uses the system zone

reserveFor.title: Reserve for
reserveFor.description: Keep the last part of the limit (from 97% of five hours, 99% of the week) for sessions marked with /limit-resume reserve, named as in 'kept for ...'; empty turns the reserve off

economyHint.title: Economy hint
economyHint.description: Extra advice added to the budget rule when the limit may run out before the reset
